column1: # What the alternation reaches with names people actually use.
# SUPERSEDES an earlier version of this file that quoted 188 for "realistic" and
# 147 for "long namespace" and blamed the namespace for the gap. Both numbers
# matched neither escaping form and had no recorded derivation, and the
# attribution was wrong: the namespace is paid ONCE as a prefix, the adapter name
# is paid N times. Ten extra characters of namespace cost about ONE adapter.
# Two different limits bind, depending on the data plane:
# COMPUTED, hack/alternation-ceiling.py. Re-runnable arithmetic, no cluster.
# namespace length barely matters: same names, two namespace lengths
# MEASURED on the cluster, three data planes, realistic profile
# Fitted from those three rejections: program size ~= 0.865 * bytes + 8.4
# To reach the 4096-byte ceiling a data plane needs a program-size limit of ~3550.
# kgateway does not expose the setting, so there it is unavailable, not untuned.
